title: A meta-interaction basis for cell-cell communication in tissues.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
journalName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
snippet: Tissue function depends on signals exchanged between cells and the responses they elicit. Yet whether diverse cell-cell interactions in situ form recurrent sender-receiver programs remains unclear. We present SpiderNet, an interpretable representation-learning framework that discovers such directed programs as a compact basis of cell-cell meta-interactions....
